description: This Java class handles the 'delete' command for product mix entities within the loan product module. It implements a command handler interface, invokes the service to delete a product mix based on the provided command, and is decorated with Spring annotations for dependency injection and transaction management.

classes.name: DeleteProductMixCommandHandler
classes.description: A command handler class responsible for processing delete commands for loan product mix entities.

methods.name: DeleteProductMixCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the ProductMixWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command by invoking the service to delete the product mix based on the command's product ID.
